title: MEIKO — To Be More And More Supportive〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: To Be More And More Supportive（2★）
meta.Event: At The End of The Unraveled Thread

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Nice work today!
See you at tomorrow's show♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Our rehearsal went off without a hitch, so I'm sure everyone's going to enjoy the show tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hm? Minori...?
What are you doing here all by yourself?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... Can I ask for a favor?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, you've been trying to practice answering questions that you may be asked during your iHaz shoot, but you're not sure if you're going about it correctly?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah... That's why I kinda want to talk to someone about this, but it's pretty late and the others are probably already asleep...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Which brought you to us.
Hehe. It's nice to hear that we're reliable.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's because you guys are.
You've helped me out so much already...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Then, don't hesitate to ask.
Especially since I want your TV appearance to lead to more and more people learning about you girls.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-MEIKO...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much! I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
“So, let's bring in our guests!
Give a big round of applause for MORE MORE JUMP!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Don't give up on your dreams, Minorinrin! Here's a bouquet of hope for you! Hello!
I'm Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “Your fans helped make the outfits you're wearing today, right?”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, they did...!
We were really worried about what outfits to wear since it's our first time appearing on TV...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we decided to wear these for this appearance because we wanted to tell all our fans just how much we appreciate what they've done for us!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I see...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How did I do, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to do better during the actual shoot, so please don't hold back! Lay it on me!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay....

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Firstly...
Your mouth was a bit all over the place.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Wah! W-Wait!
HEIKO, my heeksh! Hat hickles!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That should loosen them up a little.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: When you were speaking just now, Minori, you sounded like you were in a big hurry.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, really. Even for the parts where you need to stop and take a breath, you rushed ahead seemingly in order to introduce yourself as quickly as you could.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (She wants to do her best, but that may be causing her to become a little too anxious or flustered.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(But I understand how she feels...
Shizuku already mentioned how she wants the shoot to go well by explaining what happened between her and Cheerful * Days.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Minori, nothing good will come about if you panic.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, try focusing on saying what you want one word at a time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Let's start by taking a deep breath!
Breathe in... Breathe out...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Breathe in... Breathe out...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: One more time! Breathe in... Breathe out...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Breathe in... Breathe out...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
“So, let's bring in our guests!
Give a big round of applause for MORE MORE JUMP!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Don't give up on your dreams, Minorinrin! Here's a bouquet of hope for you! Hello!
I'm Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, excellent♪
You introduced yourself much better this time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think I have a much better idea of what I need to do now!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.
Then, let's keep practicing while we have some momentum!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Oh, before we do...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I came up with some questions that aren't in the script that I think they're going to ask us! Would you mind taking a look at them?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, I'd love to hear any that you come up with that you think I missed!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Of course!
Let's practice as much as we can♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
